dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Non-germinal-center (Hans) phenotype: CD10 negative, BCL6 positive

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Cell-of-origin by gene expression and MYD88, CD79B and TP53 genotyping have not been done.
dx_hans_not_abc.note: Notes GEP COO not done but does not say Hans is only a surrogate for ABC.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV-B with bulky disease (X).

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: I score the splenic lesions as extranodal, giving stage IV.
stage_spleen_nodal.note: Acknowledges Lugano view but explicitly rejects it.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: retroperitoneal conglomerate 11.0 x 8.1 cm (bulky, 10 cm or more)

mn_stage_iv.quote: I score the splenic lesions as extranodal, giving stage IV.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: ECOG 1 and one extranodal site score zero
mn_spleen_extranodal_count.note: Counts the spleen as one extranodal site, though it does not change the IPI/CNS-IPI totals.

mol_de_not_dh.quote: FISH negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI 3 (age over 60, stage III-IV, LDH above ULN; ECOG 1 and one extranodal site score zero), which is high-intermediate

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI about 3 of 5: age over 60 (1), stage III-IV (1), LDH above ULN (1)
prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.note: Score 3 correct but risk band not named and spleen treated as an extranodal site.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles of 21 days: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Fallback is R-CHOP-21 x 6 if polatuzumab is unavailable or not covered

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Residual uptake at Deauville 4-5 in the retroperitoneal mass: consolidative RT to about 30-36 Gy

mn_da_epoch.quote: Not DA-EPOCH-R, which is reserved for true double-hit disease

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: Start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir) now, before the first rituximab dose, and continue for at least 12 months after the last rituximab

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Check ALT and HBV DNA every 3 months during treatment and 12 months after.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: no routine CNS-directed prophylaxis (no intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate) and no baseline lumbar puncture or brain MRI

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET about 3-4 weeks after cycle 6
resp_eot_pet_lugano.note: EOT PET with Deauville scoring planned, but timing early and Lugano only implied.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: consolidative RT to about 30-36 Gy, or biopsy first if the residual mass is growing
resp_ds45_biopsy.note: Biopsy only if the mass is growing; default is RT without biopsy.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Start allopurinol 300 mg daily now and hydrate; check K, phosphate, creatinine and uric acid at baseline and on days 1-3.

sup_gcsf.quote: primary pegfilgrastim (or biosimilar) on day 4 of every cycle

work_echo_reviewed.quote: echo 2026-09-08 with LVEF 58% and GLS -20% is adequate for doxorubicin

miss_hbv_dna.quote: HBV DNA quantitative level (not done; HBsAg negative, anti-HBc and anti-HBs reactive).
